title: loop.v1 normaliser is unwired and duplicates adapters.py
acceptance_criteria: WHEN a lane report is normalised THE SYSTEM SHALL use exactly one implementation of denial extraction and text extraction

verification.expect: two independent definitions of the same constant

notes: loop_envelope.py landed as P0 of ADR 0001 with 28 passing controls, but nothing imports it except its own test. adapters.py already defines DENIAL_KEYS, envelope_denials() and the same ('result','response','output','text','content') fallback. Two implementations of the same rule drift. Decide: wire loop.v1 into adapters.normalize_report and delete the duplicate, or drop loop_envelope.py and move its status-derivation into adapters.py. Do NOT leave both.

title: no CI: every gate in this repo runs only when a human remembers
acceptance_criteria: WHEN a commit is pushed THE SYSTEM SHALL run validate.sh and fail on a red gate
notes: This repo's entire thesis is that checks must be able to fail, and it has no .github/ at all -- seven suites that run only when someone types the command. The worked example of the defect it teaches.
